notes.title: Beta V 0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][b]Notes:[/b] For this update the focus is on new features such as newspaer storyline chapters, customer reactions ("gossip?"), terrace area, new creature NPCs, gameplay and controller adjustments and more.

[b]Beta 0.1 patch release:[/b][/p][p]September 6th, 2025
[/p][p][b]NEW:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Newspaper Storyline:[/b] All newspaper articles have been added and organized into chapters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NPC Gossip:[/b] NPCs now react and “gossip” based on the newspaper article of the day.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Dialogue:[/b] Additional dialogue interactions with NPCs tied to progression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Creature NPCs:[/b] New characters introduced to the world.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Terrace Area:[/b] Terrace and related upgrades are now available.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NPC Terrace Behavior:[/b] NPCs will now hang out on the terrace once unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p][b]River Rewards:[/b] Miscellaneous items can now be caught in the river for extra rewards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pastry Tooltips:[/b] Pastry inventory now shows detailed tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pastry Management:[/b] Auto-add and auto-remove all pastries from inventory to display.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay Adjustments:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Build mode can now be used while the café is open.[/p][/*][*][p]Time pauses when build mode is active.[/p][/*][*][p]Player can now go to sleep anytime, as long as the café has been opened and closed that day.[/p][/*][*][p]Time remains paused until the café is opened.[/p][/*][*][p]Customer waiting time increased to allow latte art to be completed at a reasonable pace.[/p][/*][*][p]A limit on active decor orders has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Pastries can now only be ordered during the day.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Controller:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Visual controller UI instructions added (with gamepad detection).[/p][/*][*][p]Cursor sensitivity decreased during latte art.[/p][/*][*][p]Brewing panel navigation sensitivity fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Zoom sensitivity is now based on stick input rather than one fixed speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Cancel keybind selection added in settings.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Main menu button text sometimes not appearing.[/p][/*][*][p]Parsley NPC sitting animation fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Orders filling automatically on Day 1 without any customers.[/p][/*][*][p]“Sell Items” section in the shop now correctly displays selected item information.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pastry displays being placeable in the bedroom.[/p][/*][*][p]Fireplace lag on first ignition resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed customers not spawning after max level was reached.[/p][/*][*][p]Cups no longer remain stuck on pastry displays.[/p][/*][*][p]Matcha whisk freezing when exiting the brewing panel fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Navigation error when no pastries are available to buy for the day fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Navigation skipping the hot chocolate heater in the brewing panel fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Miscellaneous UI edits.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new SFX (café opening, wrong coffee order, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]NPC section in the journal now shows which day each NPC unlocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Locked newspaper articles are now visible in the journal.[/p][/*][*][p]NPC collision removed to prevent them from getting stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]New scene transition animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Terrace ambience sounds added.[/p][/*][*][p]Sandbox time slider replaced with a day/night toggle.[/p][/*][*][p]Bedroom window is now openable.[/p][/*][*][p]Miscellaneous keyboard and controller adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]Extended the café and sandbox soundtracks.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: General Update (Aug 2025)
notes.notes:
[h3][b]🎉 Game developing progress![/b][/h3][p]It’s been a little while since I shared the first Alpha and playtest versions of the game, and I’ve been quietly working on monthly updates, polishing features, and listening closely to your feedback. This update is a little reflection on where the game is currently now and where it's heading![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/e84640f96080e67bc6b8b1ced1d443488ceb8204.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]☕️ Looking Back: The First Alpha Milestone[/b][/h3][p]The very first Alpha release launched with the foundation of what will be Tailside’s Early Access experience. Here's what was already up and running back then:[/p][p][/p][p]🟢 Expanded different drink recipes: [b]8/8 COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Expanded decor: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Village (NPC) customers: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Day and night cycle: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Bedroom area: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Accessibility: Missing Day & Night cycle length setting [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Save & Load system: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Controller support: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]
[b]Since that release,[/b] these features have continued to evolve, improving based on your playtest feedback. From polish and visual clarity to control and comfort, everyone's input has shaped every corner of the experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]☕️ Growing Beyond the Plan[/b][/h3][p]As development progressed, Tailside expanded far beyond its original scope. New features, many not part of the original roadmap, have found their way into the game, more than doubling the planned content:

🟢 Skill Tree: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Custom Character Import: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Shop & Delivery System: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Brewing and Cafe upgrades: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Newspaper storyline: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Journal: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Pastry buying & selling: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Some of these were born from spontaneous inspiration, others from cozy community suggestions and I'm happy the alpha testers have been enjoying them so far as well![/p][p][/p][h3][b]☕️ Next update content[/b][/h3][p]It seems that since last alpha update, there's not that much issues to fix, so I have been already working towards next update this week with new things while another dev is helping fix up some issues around:

🟢 Mini storyline chapters through newspaper making the game feel somewhat like having a start and end[/p][p]🟢 Characters will have speech bubble reactions in general once approached and also reactions to current day's newspaper[/p][p]🟢 Terrace area preview[/p][p]🟢 UI adjusted to controller displays instead of only keyboard/mouse so all the players with controllers can have proper instructions[/p][p]🔴 And then the last thing that is missing now before the next update would be some gameplay adjustments to match the newspaper and terrace additions so it actually makes sense in the game haha and of course some retesting to make sure it's all playable.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/d57e391d203d1ec3f1dd8b8d92e39d4319886ee0.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]☕️ Debut Festival 2025: August 7–11[/b][/h3][p]Tailside will be part of a special Steam festival event [b]"Debut Festival 2025" from August 7–11![/b] This event features various game developers that are debutting their first games. During the time of this festival, Tailside Demo together with the Sandbox Playtest will be available to play.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]☕️ Thank You for Being Here[/b][/h3][p]Whether you played the Alpha, shared a kind word, wishlisted, or just quietly followed along, thank you. Your support means the world to this small café in the woods.[/p][p]

[b]If you would like to be part of the development journey,[/b] you can vote on various ideas on:
[url="https://discord.com/invite/3Q9WJ2V7bA"]Discord[/url] | [url="https://x.com/CoffeeBeansDev"]Twitter[/url] | [url="https://www.instagram.com/coffeebeansdev/"]Instagram[/url] | [url="https://forms.gle/56vRkPBoaJ1Vshuh7"]Leave your own suggestions[/url]
[i]Thank you so much for the support[/i] [b]- Coffee Beans Dev[/b][/p]

notes.title: Alpha V 0.12 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Notes:[/h3][/b]
This update mostly focuses on a few known alpha bugs and on the build (decor) mode system as it’s a big part of the game, I want to ensure it’s enjoyable.

[b][h3]Alpha 0.1.2 Update & Fixes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed tips timer appearing when there is no order.
[*] Fixed cafe counters not appearing in build mode inventory when in the bedroom (buttons remain disabled since cafe counters only exist in the cafe).
[*] Fixed ordered items not showing up in inventory.
[*] Added new NPC appearances as you progress through the days in the game.
[*] Added a few new newspaper issues with hints about the new NPCs.
[*] Fixed floors, wallpapers, and cafe counters appearing in the shop even after being purchased.
[*] Added a missing panel slider in the shop orders panel.
[*] Added a missing panel slider in the shop sell panel.
[*] Fixed the ability to claim multiple items from orders when clicking rapidly.
[*] Added additional safeguards to the cleaning bar system.
[*] Slightly reduced NPC customer chance to better balance NPC and creature appearances in the cafe.
[*] Improved tab visibility for the shop and journal panels.
[*] Added instructional UI for opening/closing the cafe to reduce confusion at the start of a new day.
[*] Added a note on the cafe’s glass door hinting at future updates.
[*] You can now turn on the fireplace in your bedroom.
[/list]

[b][h3]Build mode and Sandbox improvements:[/h3][/b] (Included in Playtest version)
[list]
[*] Saving/loading items on tables should now work correctly and no longer place them behind.
[*] Saving/loading of floor and wallpaper designs should now be fixed.
[*] Fixed items on tables loading in incorrect positions and layers.
[*] Added item categories.
[*] Added the ability to enable/disable the build mode inventory to avoid blocking the view while placing items.
[*] Added the ability to continue placing the same item without needing to reselect it each time.
[*] Added the ability to flip certain items (such as plants and some others).
[*] The small calendar can now be placed on walls.
[*] You can now decorate the middle wall with the staircase door.
[*] An indication for rotate/flip functionality is now shown when available for selected items.
[*] Chairs should no longer glitch through the middle wall.
[*] Restored the ability to decorate the top of the cafe counter.
[*] Added the option to decorate the sides of the cafe counter with small "wall" objects (e.g., calendar, sticky notes…).
[*] Items that cannot be placed will now turn red for better clarity.
[*] Fixed issues that allowed placing items outside of designated rooms.
[/list]

[b][h3]New Sandbox items:[/h3][/b] (Included in Playtest version)
[list]
[*] More carpets (+20)
[*] Simple shelves (+12)
[*] Little Creatures (+4)
[*] Coffee cups and brewing items (+14)
[*] Colorful sticky notes (+7)
[*] Vertical book stacks (+2)
[*] [b]Total new items: 59[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha V 0.11 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b][h3]Notes:[/h3][/b]
This update requires deleting any existing save files. Please start a new game after updating.

[b][h3]New features:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Sandbox Mode: Decorate with no limits!
[*] You can now pet the little creatures
[*] Chair placement now shows which direction the chair is facing
[*] Coffee bean sorting is now the first activity of each in-game day
[*] Coffee bean sorting now grants XP
[*] Added this Patch Notes Panel for quick update summaries!
[/list]

[b][h3]Fixes & Other[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where standing and wall signs couldn’t be selected
[*] Fixed tabletop plants saving with the wrong layer
[*] Fixed save file loading issues
[*] "Skip Introduction" button no longer overlaps other UI elements
[*] Reduced sale chance of single items (e.g., floors, cafe counters) to 1%
[*] Added missing cafe counter designs UI elements in the brewing panel
[*] Fixed issue where the cafe couldn’t be cleaned or its cleanliness increased
[*] Fixed UI panel blocking decor placement on the right side of the cafe
[*] Fixed day summary values for money earned and spent
[*] Fixed issue with newly purchased items not appearing in inventory
[*] Introduction package now correctly adds items to inventory
[*] Decor placement on the cafe counter disabled to prepare for future upgrades
[*] Item interactions are now disabled in build mode
[*] Fixed tooltip incorrectly showing coffee order names with no order
[*] Fixed issue with tips bar not resetting with wrong coffee completion
[*] Fixed latte pouring being stuck enabled
[*] Fixed scrolling the settings menu causing scrolling in-game
[*] Fixed music restarting even if it’s at 0 volume in settings
[*] Music entering pause menu now fades out/in
[*] Fixed some decor item layering loading issues
[*] Fixed skills not working properly
[*] Reduced the XP multiplier per level to help players progress a bit faster
[*] Fixed some issues with wall decor clipping through or appearing on windows
[*] Added ability to place certain decor items on the fireplace
[*] Fixed Maple's (the bear) sitting sprite to include a coffee cup
[*] Made some edits to NPC behavior: previously, chairs were always chosen in the same order — now it's randomized
[*] Fixed item selling list to include all the newly added decor items
[*] Added light rotation indicators to some dark chairs for better visibility
[*] Fixed some optimization issues in the shop
[*] Added a new time-balancing structure for order delivery to make delivery times feel more varied between items
[*] Various minor UI issues, asset tweaks, and spelling corrections
[/list]

[b][h3]Known issues:[/h3][/b]
- Ongoing controller and keyboard binding issues
